conversation.content: Tell me about the Turnover Agent
The Turnover Agent is a Telegram-first operations bot Joe built for a short-term-rental property manager: one LLM agent with 32 tools on a single Docker container.
Joe's main stack is React, TypeScript, Vite and Tailwind on the front end; for AI he uses an Anthropic-compatible Messages API with RAG on Supabase, and Ollama Cloud models for his own agents.
Going back to the Turnover Agent, how many tools does it have?

conversation.content: What experience does Joe have with AI?

Joe has been building AI systems in production for 5+ years. Hermes runs his own business with 40+ scheduled automations behind a C-suite + VP agent structure, and he ships AI agents for clients, like the Turnover Agent for a short-term-rental manager.

conversation.content: Tell me about The Skate Workshop

The Skate Workshop is a React Native app Joe built for Willy Santos, an Olympic-level skateboarding coach: 4,900+ trick-obstacle training combinations on a 19-table Supabase backend, live on iOS via TestFlight.
Joe's main stack is React, TypeScript, Vite and Tailwind on the front end; for AI he uses an Anthropic-compatible Messages API with RAG on Supabase, and Ollama Cloud models for his own agents.
